records.ggc:
"The right bank of the Volga River, 25 km above the town of the town of Ul'yanovsk, between the Zakhar'yevskoye mine and the Detskiy sanatorium."

Ochev & Efimov (1985: 87) stated that the holotype of Simbirskiasaurus birjukovi: ‘was discovered several years ago on the right bank of the Volga River, 25 km above the town of Ulyanovsk, between the Zakhar’yevskoye mine and the children’s sanatorium’, but this is unlikely as no Barremian strata are found in this area (I.V. Blagoveschensky, pers. comm., May 2013). Blagoveschensky & Shumilkin (2004) described a nearby Barremian section, between Ulyanovsk and Polivno, with abundant Aconeceras specimens, hence providing a possible source locality for YKM 65119. This corroborates the account of an eyewitness of the discovery (S.E. Biryukov, pers. comm., May 2013).
